message.content:
Review: The problem is clearly framed as a causal follow-up, with a defined system, proposed interventions, paired measurements, and a robustness test. It also distinguishes what the supplied aggregate data suggest from what they cannot establish. The target paper’s published claim is appropriately treated as context rather than as a new finding.

Feedback: Clarify how “onset” and “robustness” of time-crystalline order will be operationalized—for example, which temporal-order metric and threshold define onset, and how robustness will be compared across drive and disorder perturbations. “Varying coupling or initial conditions” also leaves open which parameter changes are feasible and how they will isolate coarsening rate from other effects. Finally, correlation length may not be a single unambiguous quantity; specify how it will be estimated and at what timescale it will be compared with temporal order. These details would make the proposed causal test more reproducible.

Rating (1-5): 4
